jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Credit
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Credit

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our Senior Product Manager - Credit, you'll take full ownership of our Credit business line within the Features & Payment domain, focusing on innovative solutions such as Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) to build and scale financial products for millions of users. Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - New Business Line Leadership – Drive the strategy and execution for BNPL products, taking features from 0 to 1 and managing their scaling phase.

 - Consumer-Facing Experience – Focus on the UX and customer-facing side of credit, ensuring complex financial tools are intuitive, transparent, and seamlessly integrated into Satispay.

 - Cross-functional Alignment – Act as a strategic orchestrator across Finance, Marketing, Data Science, and Fincrime/Fraud to align priorities around a shared product vision.

 - Product Definition & Documentation – Write clear user stories and requirements for Engineering, aligning frontend experiences with backend logic such as credit scoring and collection.

 - Data-Driven Optimization – Analyze product usage and performance metrics to optimize credit features and uncover new market opportunities.

 - Process Evangelism & Mentorship – Advocate for thorough documentation and efficient workflows to help the team anticipate obstacles and ensure smooth product delivery.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone with the resilience to build a new business pillar and a problem-solving mindset focused on team-driven success.

 - Product Experience – 5+ years as a Product Manager, including at least 3 years specifically within the Credit domain.

 - Launch & Growth Track Record – Proven experience launching products from scratch and scaling them through growth phases.

 - Financial & Analytical Skills – Strong understanding of credit scoring, collection management, and overall financial mechanics.

 - Stakeholder Management – Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Engineering, UX, BI, Finance).

 - Language Skills – Professional fluency in English.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

 - 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.

The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. jobs.title: Product Lead - Business & Merchant Domain
jobs.description:
About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.



What you'll be doing

As our Product Lead – Business & Merchant Domain, you’ll drive the evolution of our Business ecosystem and the products supporting the financial needs of companies. In this role, you will lead a team of business domain PMs while remaining directly hands-on with execution. This position requires a rare blend of product delivery, strategic leadership, and a powerful growth mindset to thrive in complexity, raise quality benchmarks, and continuously build product experiences that drive commercial success.

Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

 - Product Leadership & Execution –  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle. Define the roadmap, design frictionless experiences, and deliver high-impact features.

 - Strategic Coordination –  Mentor and coordinate Product Managers, ensuring cross-team collaboration, alignment, and a unified product vision.

 - Drive Commercial Growth & Engagement – Apply a strong growth mindset to design solutions that reactivate dormant merchants, increase feature adoption, boost upselling, and optimize conversion funnels.

 - Business & Customer Understanding – Develop a deep understanding of businesses' financial needs, market dynamics and competitive landscape, translating customer and market insights into product opportunities.

 - User-Centricity – Put merchants first by obsessing over user feedback, conducting continuous shadowing, and transforming pain points into seamless opportunities.

 - Data-Driven Decision Making – Define, track, and analyze key product metrics to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and relentlessly optimize funnel performance.



What We Are Looking For

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in!

Does this sound like you?

 - B2B Product Management – 5+ years of experience in B2B Product Management, preferably within Business Banking, Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, B2B SaaS, or high-growth tech environments.

 - Financial Services Experience - Experience building or scaling products in banking, fintech or other financial services environments is a strong plus.

 - Leadership & Complexity Management – Experience managing people or leading highly complex, multi-stakeholder projects across organizational and technical boundaries.

 - Commercial Acumen / Growth Mindset – A strong business sense with an understanding of how to leverage product experiences to drive monetization, acquisition, and merchant engagement.

 - Obsession with Detail – High standards with a sharp eye for UX/UI details, copy, and operational excellence to constantly raise the bar.

 - Analytical Power – Deeply data-driven mindset with experience using advanced data platforms to track metrics, optimize funnels, and turn raw data into actionable strategic growth insights.

 - AI-Empowered Product Management – Strong AI fluency with the ability to integrate AI tools into daily workflows to accelerate product operations, research synthesis, and roadmap structuring.

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing - Merchant
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. 

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. 

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. 

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.



What you'll be doing

As our Head of Product Marketing - Merchant, you'll own the product marketing strategy for our entire Merchant business and drive merchant acquisition, activation, and loyalty. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Own the Merchant Product Marketing Strategy - Define and drive the go-to-market vision for all Merchant products, ensuring positioning, messaging, and launch plans are tightly aligned with commercial and business goals.

 - Lead Launches for New Products - Own go-to-market for new merchant offerings as they roll out – from established products like Business Premium to upcoming additions to our merchant toolkit – shaping narrative, positioning, and launch strategy from the ground up, often ahead of public announcement.

 - Build and Lead a Small, High-Impact Team - Hire, coach, and grow a lean team of product marketing specialists, setting a high bar for craft and ownership. With a small team, you'll be hands-on day to day – shaping briefs, reviewing work closely, and stepping in on execution where needed, not just delegating.

 - Drive Go-to-Market Excellence - Lead end-to-end launches for new merchant products and features, from positioning and narrative to sales enablement, channel strategy, and post-launch measurement.

 - Partner Across the Business - Act as the key link between Product, Sales, Business Development, CRM, and Creative teams, ensuring merchant-facing strategies are grounded in real market and merchant needs.

 - Shape Merchant Segmentation & Value Propositions - Develop differentiated value propositions across merchant segments (micro, SMB, enterprise) to maximize relevance, adoption, and retention.

 - Own the Merchant Narrative - Define how Satispay talks to merchants – across sales materials, campaigns, product comms, and events – ensuring consistency and clarity at every touchpoint.

 - Drive Data-Informed Decisions - Set clear KPIs for merchant acquisition and engagement, using data to prioritize investments and continuously refine strategy.

 - Represent Merchant Marketing at Leadership Level - Bring insights, plans, and results to senior stakeholders, influencing broader company strategy on the merchant side of the business.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.



Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: shaping and executing the merchant growth narrative and go-to-market strategy across diverse segments while building a high-impact product marketing engine from the ground up. 
We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

 - Senior Leadership Experience, with a Hands-On Mindset - 10+ years of marketing experience, including leading product marketing or B2B marketing teams, while remaining comfortable writing briefs directly.

 - B2B / Merchant Marketing Background - Hands-on experience marketing to businesses or merchants, ideally in payments, fintech, or another two-sided marketplace.

 - Comfortable Building, Not Just Managing - Energized by shaping a small team's ways of working from scratch rather than stepping into an established setup.

 - Excellent Communication Skills - Ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and compellingly in both written and verbal form to audiences from team members to senior leadership.

 - Comfortable in a Fast-Paced Environment - Highly driven and goal-oriented, with experience in fast-paced or tech company environments.

 - Commercial & Data-Driven Mindset - Strong grasp of commercial levers behind merchant acquisition and retention, leveraging data to guide decisions and prioritization.

 - Strategic Decision-Making - Ability to prioritize and make informed decisions under resource constraints in a dynamic environment while anticipating future needs.

 - Innovation & Execution - Proven track record of translating strategic insights into actionable plans and tangible business results.

 - Cross-Functional Influence - Demonstrated ability to build trust and alignment across Sales, Product, and Business Development teams without direct authority.

 - Languages - Fluent in both Italian and English.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.



Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

 - Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.

 - Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.

 - Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

 - Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.
   
   

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our Senior Product Manager of the Investments domain, you'll be the person who makes investing radically simple and accessible for our users, across any asset type they want to put their money into.

Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

 - Roadmap ownership - Own the roadmap for our investment products (ETFs, stocks, ready-made funds, money market funds, pension funds), from opportunity sizing to shipped feature, backed by data and user research.

 - Regulatory complexity - Navigate the added complexity of investment products, balancing simplicity for the user with the regulatory and product intricacy underneath.

 - Compliance collaboration - Work closely with compliance/legal given the regulated nature of investment products.

 - User research - Talk to users constantly (interviews, usability tests, support tickets) and turn what you hear into concrete product decisions.

 - Execution & iteration - Define specs and work day-to-day with design and engineering to ship, then iterate based on what the numbers tell you.

 - KPI management - Track and own your core KPIs (activation, adoption, AUM/volumes) and report on them without spin.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone data-driven and user-centric, who thrives on turning complex investment products into simple, engaging consumer experiences.

 - Experience - at least 6+ years of experience in a Product Manager role, ideally with exposure to regulated products (investing, lending, insurance) or genuine complexity.

 - Investments expertise - You bring a proven track record in the investment space, paired with a genuine, contagious passion for the world of finance

 - Data-driven mindset - You build hypotheses, validate them, and rely on analytics to lead the way

 - User-centric focus - You prioritize direct user feedback and research over unverified assumptions.

 - Cross-functional collaboration - You thrive working alongside designers and engineers every day, staying involved far beyond just handing over specifications.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops)

 - 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you’re moving countries)

 - ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply)

 - 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours)

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness)

*We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.



Salary: €68.000 - €87.000 gross per annum

This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise.
